body:
Hi @IgorAufricht, thanks for reporting the issue.

It looks like the problem was caused by the following code (the sequence of calls) in Ivy TestBed code (where locale is set first and initializers are called after that):
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4419907b08948b9f7b3b835658d319a4573ea374/packages/core/testing/src/r3_test_bed_compiler.ts#L260-L266

Please note: the `runInitializers` call happens synchronously here, which is also the case with View Engine TestBed (see [test_bed.ts](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/core/testing/src/test_bed.ts#L413)), so your initializers in tests should be synchronous.

I will look into this problem more and keep this thread updated.

Thank you.

issue.body:
Prior to this commit, Ivy TestBed was accessing locale ID before `APP_INITIALIZER` functions were called. This execution order is not consistent with the app bootstrap logic in the `application_ref.ts` file. This commit updates Ivy TestBed execution order to call initializers first (since they might affect `LOCALE_ID` token value) and accessing and setting locale ID after that.

Related changes were performed in the `application_ref.ts` file in PR #34830.

Fixes #36230.
